page.notes: The Hebrew forms are copied as far as legible. Several vocalised Hebrew forms in the first column (e.g. the forms after "bestia", "vivens", "somnium") and the Hebrew after "R." at the top of the left column are small and doubtful; they may contain errors of vowel points and are not checked against a source. The Hebrew of the right column's first entries (חלק, חמא) and the vowel points of "חֲשִׁחִין" are uncertain. Entries are given one per paragraph; the wrapped lines of each entry are joined. The Latin "long s" is written as s throughout. Verify Hebrew forms against the scan before use.
